2. Corriger le test flaky verification.test.js:101
3. Vérifier fraîcheur dist/ vs src/
4. Panneau MCP avec relance individuelle des serveurs en erreur

steps.text: Panneau MCP avec relance individuelle des serveurs en erreur
Connecter C3 à ses actions mémoire/indexation réelles
Cowork enrichi avec actions métier pilotées par les MCP disponibles
Ajouter un vrai aperçu local du workspace (pas seulement URL externe)
Build final + tests complets + synthèse FR

1.1 List files and folders in workspace with sizes
1.2 Check git status: staged vs unstaged changes
1.3 Run `npm run build` and verify no TypeScript errors (exit code 0)
1.4 Run `npm test` and verify all tests pass (no flaky failures)

2.1 Identify the flaky test verification.test.js:101
2.2 Analyze the race condition with ready.txt and verify.cjs
2.3 Propose a fix for the race condition

3.1 Compare dist/ with src/ for freshness (file sizes, timestamps)
3.2 Ensure no silent corruption between src/ and dist/

4.1 Identify which MCP servers are installed and their status
4.2 Check if individual server restarts are possible
4.3 Design a MCP panel with individual server restart capability

5.1 Inspect C3's memory/indexation state
5.2 Map C3's memory actions to real indexation
5.3 Connect C3's memory/indexation to the workspace indexation system

6.1 Identify available MCP providers for business tasks
6.2 Design a Cowork panel with role-based permission management
6.3 Add business task templates and execution workflows

7.1 Analyze workspace structure (src, dist, tests, plugins)
7.2 Design a local workspace preview (file list, tree, size)
7.3 Implement the local workspace preview

8.1 Run a full build and verify all outputs
8.2 Run all tests and verify no failures
8.3 Generate a final synthesis report in French

9.1 Check dist/ and src/ for file size consistency
9.2 Check dist/ and src/ for timestamp consistency
9.3 Compare dist/ with src/ line-by-line for silent corruption

10.1 Check MCP server status (installed, running, version)
10.2 Check if individual server restart is possible
10.3 Analyze MCP server restart mechanism

11.1 Inspect C3's memory state and indexation state
11.2 Map C3's memory actions to real indexation operations
11.3 Design the connection between C3's memory and workspace indexation

12.1 Check available MCP providers (mail, sheets, browser, etc.)
12.2 Analyze MCP provider capabilities for business tasks
12.3 Design role-based permission management for Cowork

13.1 Analyze workspace structure: src/, dist/, tests/, plugins/
13.2 Analyze file types and relationships in workspace
13.3 Design local workspace preview: file list, tree, size, metadata

14.1 Check build output for completeness
14.2 Check test output for completeness
14.3 Generate synthesis report in French

15.1 Analyze TypeScript/JavaScript file types in src/
15.2 Analyze dependencies and their versions
15.3 Analyze workspace dependencies for build/test

16.1 Analyze workspace dependencies for build and test
16.2 Check if dependencies are up-to-date
16.3 Analyze dependency management strategy

17.1 Check build output for completeness
17.2 Check test output for completeness
17.3 Verify build and test run without errors

18.1 Generate synthesis report in French
18.2 Verify synthesis report completeness
18.3 Finalize plan
